nodes.norm_label: keepass-style merge by uuid/mtime with deletedobjects

nodes.norm_label: q15 - i18n and assets (fluent, inter, phosphor)

nodes.label: graphify knowledge-graph refresh workflow
nodes.rationale: Query graph before exploring codebase to save tokens.

nodes.label: RemoteStore trait
nodes.rationale: Puts Drive behind a trait so sync can be tested without the network (fake RemoteStore).

nodes.label: Build-time credential embedding (KEEPSAVE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET via .env)
nodes.rationale: Mechanism to be confirmed in milestone 4.

nodes.label: Desktop app OAuth client
nodes.rationale: Google does not treat desktop client secret as confidential; security comes from PKCE and loopback redirect.

nodes.label: OAuth consent screen (External, In production)
nodes.rationale: Testing mode refresh tokens expire after 7 days; drive.file is non-sensitive so publishing needs no verification review.

nodes.label: Dependency direction app -> sync -> core
nodes.rationale: Core stays free of UI, network and async so it is testable and reusable.

nodes.label: Never block the UI thread
nodes.rationale: Argon2 and network work run on background tokio runtime, communicating with UI over channels.

nodes.label: Workflow with the user (manual commits, roadmap ticking, graphify refresh)
nodes.norm_label: workflow with the user (manual commits, roadmap ticking, graphify refresh)
nodes.rationale: User commits manually; Claude suggests Conventional Commit messages; design changes go to DESIGN.md first.

nodes.label: Q11 - OAuth (Desktop client, loopback + PKCE, drive.file)
nodes.norm_label: q11 - oauth (desktop client, loopback + pkce, drive.file)
nodes.rationale: drive.file scope limits app to its own files in a visible KeepSave/ folder; publish In production unverified because Testing refresh tokens expire after 7 days.

nodes.label: Q14 - Cargo workspace architecture
nodes.rationale: google-drive3 not used; few REST endpoints written by hand. Background tokio runtime keeps UI thread unblocked.

nodes.label: Q18 - Password generator (character + passphrase modes)
nodes.rationale: Length 8-128 default 20, guarantees each enabled class, EFF large wordlist passphrases, entropy meter, OsRng.

nodes.label: Q1 - v1 feature set
nodes.rationale: Everything KeePass does is too large for v1; deferred features are additive and don't affect file format.

nodes.label: Q2 - KDBX4 file format
nodes.rationale: Interoperable with KeePassXC and mobile clients, audited format, single encrypted file easy to sync. SQLCipher and field-level encrypted SQLite rejected: proprietary, SQLCipher complicates Windows builds, field-level encryption leaks metadata.

nodes.label: Q4 - Desktop-only platforms
nodes.rationale: egui on mobile is experimental and lacks autofill/keyboard integration; mobile covered by KeePassDX/Strongbox/KeePassium opening the same .kdbx.

nodes.label: Q6 - Liquid glass dark visual style
nodes.norm_label: q6 - liquid glass dark visual style

nodes.label: Q8 - Simulated glass implementation (wgpu blob shader)
nodes.norm_label: q8 - simulated glass implementation (wgpu blob shader)
nodes.rationale: Background already blurred so translucent panels read as glass without real backdrop blur; optional window-vibrancy Acrylic/Mica; real blur only if simulated look falls short.

nodes.label: Secrets handling convention (secrecy/zeroize, keyring)
nodes.rationale: Never log, Debug-print, or write secrets to config.toml; OAuth tokens live in keyring.

nodes.label: KeePass-style merge by UUID/mtime with DeletedObjects
nodes.norm_label: keepass-style merge by uuid/mtime with deletedobjects
nodes.rationale: Deletions propagate via DeletedObjects; losing version goes into entry history so nothing is lost.

nodes.label: Q10 - Memory hygiene and locking
nodes.rationale: secrecy/zeroize always; auto-lock 5 min; lock on minimize and OS sleep; clipboard auto-clear 15 s only if it still holds our value.

nodes.label: Q13 - Sync behavior (triggers, change detection, offline, backups)
nodes.norm_label: q13 - sync behavior (triggers, change detection, offline, backups)
nodes.rationale: Triggers: unlock, 3 s debounced save, manual. Compare Drive version/modifiedTime with last-synced values. Back up remote to KeepSave/backups/ keeping 10.

nodes.label: Q9 - Argon2id key derivation and unlock
nodes.norm_label: q9 - argon2id key derivation and unlock
nodes.rationale: Parameters calibrated at vault creation for ~1 s unlock with ~64 MiB memory.
